d: 'A conceptual framework that merges biosemiotics with mineralogy, proposing that meaning-making and information-processing exist on a physical continuum from inorganic matter to biological cognition. It suggests that periodically ordered matter (like crystals) exhibits intrinsic sign-bearing behavior when its energetic and structural patterns communicate environmental history.' Core Concepts: Lithosemiotics ('how non-organic geologic structures encode information'), The Peircean Continuum.
